WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT constructorStandings.raceId, 
         AVG(constructorStandings.points) as avg_points, 
         AVG(constructorStandings.wins) as avg_wins 
  FROM constructorStandings 
  WHERE constructorStandings.points >= 6.0 
  GROUP BY constructorStandings.raceId
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as overall_avg_wins
  FROM step1
)
SELECT step1.raceId, 
       step1.avg_points, 
       step1.avg_wins,
       step1.avg_wins - step2.overall_avg_wins as diff
FROM step1, step2
WHERE step2.overall_avg_wins IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 10
